notes.text: CCNL signed 2020-10-08; nominally covers 2016-2018 (Art. 4). Applied in ultrattività from 2019 onwards. Salary tables (Tabella 1) effective 2020-07-01 per Art. 51. No renewal signed as of 2026-09-09. Confirmed 2026-09-09: preintesa June 2020 is the last event; all 2023-2025 bridge agreements found refer to the separate AIOP RSA contract (different CNEL code). The AIOP-ARIS ospedaliero (T011) T011 remains in pure ultrattività.
Salary values are conglobated: EADR incorporated into tabellare from 2020-07-01 per Art. 55. Back-calculation: A 1467.45×13=19076.85 ✓; C4 2076.38×13=26992.94 ✓; DS4 2418.05×13=31434.65 ✓.

28 levels (A, A1–A4, B, B1–B4, C, C1–C4, D, D1–D4, DS, DS1–DS4, E, E1, E2). Order assigned by 2020-07-01 salary because professional families A/B/C/D/DS/E have overlapping salary ranges — categories are not a single hierarchy. A4 (order 6) is paid above B (order 5) per Tabella 1. Horizontal progressions within each category are modelled as static levels per Art. 48; the engine does not auto-advance a worker's level after the contractual service threshold.

Art. 56 freezes the worker's RIA balance acquired by 31 December 1993; maximum_count=0 stops new accrual but does not provide the balance. Supply the actual preserved monthly balance as IndividualElement(code='frozen_ria', monthly=<worker balance>, absorbable=False, as_of=None, extra_months=True, tfr_relevant=True). It is paid monthly and included in the Art. 58 daily/hourly base and Art. 66 thirteenth; Art. 73 applies the ordinary TFR base. No national amount is specified.

limitation.remediation: Require the worker's actual frozen monthly RIA balance as an individual element; without that fact, no historical amount can be inferred.

source_document.title: Private healthcare 2020

location.quote: I trattamenti retributivi individuali di anzianità sono globalmente congelati e bloccati nella misura complessiva eventualmente acquisita alla data del 31 dicembre 1993.

provenance.transformation: The caller supplies the frozen monthly RIA; Art. 58 includes it in daily/hourly pay and Art. 66 in the thirteenth; ordinary recurring pay enters TFR.

notes.text: CCNL covers ospedalieri, IRCCS, riabilitazione (AIOP/ARIS members). Does not apply to RSA governed by separate AIOP RSA or Uneba agreements.

hourly_divisor=156 (Art. 58: paga giornaliera=monthly/26, oraria=giornaliera/6 for 36h/week). Levels D4, DS4, E, E1, E2 work 38h/week per Art. 18 (oraria=giornaliera/6.33, exact divisor≈164.6), modelled as 156 uniformly.

Apprenticeship (Art. 23 §14, Art. 23 §2): destination levels are the four category entry positions A, B, C, D only. Horizontal-progression steps (A1-A4, B1-B4, C1-C4, D1-D4) are not apprenticeship destinations. DS and E categories excluded per Art. 23 §2. OSS and Albo-registered health professions excluded per Art. 23 §2 but per-qualification restriction not modellable at level granularity.

INPS: terziario sector, 2026-terziario.json: employee 9.36% (up to 5 employees), 9.46% (6-15), 9.76% (above 15); employer 29.31%, 29.51% and 30.11% on the same tiers. Private healthcare (AIOP/ARIS) is classified under terziario standard rates; no healthcare-specific INPS regime applies. INPS Circolare n. 6/2026 confirms the 9.19% IVS employee rate for private sector workers. (review of 2026-10-30)

CCNL applied in ultrattività; Decreto Lavoro 2026 introduced a statutory 30% IPCA auto-adjustment if no renewal within 12 months of expiry. If triggered, legally applicable 2026 minimums may exceed the 2020 Tabella 1 values modelled here. Engine models contractual tables only.

limitation.remediation: Verify whether the statutory IPCA adjustment applies to T011 under ultrattività and model it, or record the limitation.

notes.text: CNEL code T011 verified at https://www.contratticcnl.it/ccnl/t011/ (146585 employees, ARIS/AIOP, ATECO 86).

TERM: the CCNL of 8 October 2020 renews the economic part 2016-2018 and its table applies from 1 July 2020; no later renewal signed by AIOP and ARIS was found on 14 October 2026 (the unions were still asking to open the table), so the 2020 tabellari stay in force under ultrattività.

SHIFT AND RISK ALLOWANCES (Arts. 60-61, pp. 90-91): night hours between 22:00 and 06:00 and on-call turns of 4 to 12 hours are paid from event facts. Holiday shifts (€17.82 above half the scheduled shift, €8.91 for at most half with at least two hours) remain unmodelled: scheduled shift length, night-holiday overlap and the one-per-holiday-day cap are not captured. Radiation risk (€1,239.50 annually) requires category A or medical radiology technician status and actual service time. On-call interventions, compensatory rest and the usual eight-day monthly limit are not inferred from standby turns. The source does not settle whether on-call pay enters the TFR base; the current non-TFR treatment needs independent verification.

limitation.remediation: Supply scheduled holiday shift duration, eligibility and radiation service facts and apply the holiday cap, night overlap, compensatory rest and on-call intervention rules before paying the remaining allowances.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP (CCNL 8 October 2020, apprendistato professionalizzante, point 14, p. 31): 85% of the pay of the qualifica da conseguire, then 90%, by the length of the contract: months 1-9 and 10-12 for up to 18 months (the text does not state months 13-18, which keep 90%), 1-12 and 13-24 for up to 24 months, 1-18 and 19-36 for up to 36 months. Three tracks: set Apprentice.track. Apprentices accrue no seniority 'a nessun fine'.

PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: the ore supplementari of a part-time worker take a 15% maggiorazione of the retribuzione oraria globale (Art. 22, CCNL 8 October 2020, p. 25), band OT_SUPPLEMENTARE for OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY.

DAILY ROTATING SHIFT ALLOWANCES (Art. 61(c), p. 91): EUR 4.50 per actual service day for eligible staff stably rotating across three shifts, or EUR 2.06 per day for eligible staff stably alternating at least two shifts; the two are not cumulative. The night-hour allowance does not replace them. Monthly rotation, qualifying profiles and actual days are not derived from night hours.

limitation.remediation: Supply qualifying profiles, stable monthly rotation and actual eligible service days; implement the distinct daily rates with mutual exclusion.

notes.text: ENTERPRISE ON-CALL ADOPTION AND COVERED PROFILES (Art. 60, p. 89): enterprise-level evaluation and regulation, after consultation, defines the profiles involved. The caller asserts the enterprise has adopted the service and the worker is covered by submitting on-call events; the engine does not verify the enterprise agreement or profile eligibility.

limitation.remediation: Verify the enterprise-level adoption and covered profiles before submitting on-call events; add qualifying facts if automated validation is needed.

location.quote: Gli effetti decorrono dal giorno successivo alla data di stipula, salvo che nel testo contrattuale non siano previste decorrenza diverse. | Detto servizio ha durata di 12 ore e dà diritto ad un compenso di 21,69 euro lorde per ogni 12 ore; qualora il turno di pronta disponibilità sia articolato in orari di minore durata, la predetta indennità viene corrisposta proporzionalmente alla durata stessa, maggiorata del 10%; l'articolazione del turno di pronta disponibilità non può avere, comunque, durata inferiore alle 4 ore. | Ai sensi dell'art. 2120, comma 2, cod. civ., le voci che rientrano nel t.f.r. sono le seguenti: - retribuzione come da posizione economica; - retribuzione individuale di anzianità ad personam; - elemento aggiuntivo di retribuzione (EADR) fino al 30 giugno 2020; - indennità per mansioni superiori; - indennità di coordinamento non revocabile; - superminimi; - assegni ad personam; - indennità specifiche; - indennità professionali; - premio di incentivazione; - tredicesima mensilità; - indennità sostitutiva del preavviso.

provenance.transformation: One event per turn: 12 hours pays EUR 21.69; 4 to less than 12 hours pays 21.69 * hours / 12 * 1.10. Calls require a separate work event. Signed 8 October 2020; Art. 4 starts effects on 9 October 2020. Art. 73 lists TFR elements under Art. 2120(2) but does not name pronta disponibilità; in_tfr_base=false is a provisional modelling choice, not a verified exclusion (specific or professional indemnities could require interpretation).

location.section: Art. 43 (Malattia e infortuni), comporto and Trattamento economico
location.quote: il datore di lavoro è tenuto ad integrare le prestazioni economiche assicurative sino a raggiungere: a) In caso di malattia Il 100% della retribuzione globale sino al 365° giorno di assenza nell'arco di quattro anni precedenti ad ogni inizio di malattia

provenance.transformation: From the first day the employer advances the INPS indemnity and tops it up to 100% of the retribuzione globale up to the 365th day of absence in the four years before the start of each sickness; the job is kept for 540 days in a rolling four years ('oltre il limite di 540 giorni complessivi nell'arco di un quadriennio mobile'). The treatment 'non deve essere comunque superiore a quello che il lavoratore avrebbe percepito al netto se avesse lavorato': net_basis. Not modelled: the extension to 600 and 690 days for a relapse during a long hospital stay, and the life-saving therapies left out of the comporto.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: Tabella 1 of the CCNL of 8 October 2020 for the 28 positions, the number of monthly payments and the term.
findings: The 28 monthly tabellari match column D of Tabella 1 (p. 104) to the cent: verified.
13 monthly payments: verified ('x 13 mensilità', column C).
No renewal after the CCNL of 8 October 2020 was found; the table stays in force (ultrattività). Seniority, overtime, absence and sickness rules are not re-read in this pass.

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL T011 matches. Signatories corrected: the text of 8 October 2020 is signed by AIOP and ARIS with FP-CGIL, CISL-FPS and UIL-FPL only (the report adds UGL Sanità); FILCAMS, FISASCAT, UILTuCS, FIALS and CISAL Sanità were listed by mistake.
Term: 'Decorrenza: 1° gennaio 2016 - Scadenza: 31 dicembre 2018' (Art. 4), the same in the report; the CCNL applies in ultrattività.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili': the overtime bands and the night, holiday and shift premiums of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Art. 59 (p. 89): daytime overtime is paid at 20%, not 15%: corrected. Night or holiday overtime 30% and night-holiday overtime 50% match. All four bands verified; the hourly quota is the monthly pay over 26 and 6 (Art. 58), the divisor 156 of the file.
Art. 60-61: the night and holiday shift indemnities, the on-call indemnity and the radiation risk indemnity were neither modelled nor declared: declared as an outside-input limitation.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'ferie, permessi, festività, assenze, malattia e comporto': the leave, accrual, absence and sickness rules of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Sickness (Art. 43, pp. 58-60): the employer tops up to 100% of the retribuzione globale from the first day up to the 365th day of absence in four years, within a comporto of 540 days in a rolling four years, net of what the worker would have received working. The file paid 50% in the waiting days and 75% after, up to 180 days: corrected and verified.
Ferie (Art. 32, p. 42): 30 working days plus 4 days for the festività soppresse, 34 in all (was 30): corrected and verified.
Absence divisor 26 (Art. 58, p. 88) and the tredicesima accrual of more than 15 days (Art. 66, p. 96, was assumed): verified.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova': the apprenticeship tracks and the part-time supplementary hours of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Apprenticeship (p. 31): only the 36-month track (85% then 90%) was modelled; the 18-month and 24-month tracks are added. An apprentice now names the track.
Part-time supplementary hours are paid at 15% (Art. 22, p. 25): declared, the request cannot state them.
Probation and fixed-term rules carry no amount the engine computes.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the pension, health and bilateral contributions of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The CCNL of 8 October 2020 sets no contractual pension, health or bilateral contribution: Art. 74 only confirms the will to institute a supplementary pension. None is modelled.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-31: the minimi of every level against the CCNL of 8 October 2020, the status of the renewal, and the readiness of the file.
findings: The 28 minimi of the file are printed in the CCNL of 8 October 2020. Match.

No renewal of the CCNL 2016-2018 was signed by 2026-10-17: the unions report a contract in ultrattività and a dispute open in January 2026 (FP CGIL, letter to the Ministry of Health and the Conferenza delle Regioni); the 2020 tables stay in force.

Not promoted to reviewed: verification.confidence is unverified, the level records are derived from a CCNL text of 2020 with an aggregator as second source, and shift_on_call_allowances and part_time_supplementary_rate are open. The derived rule stays derived.

reviews.scope: Frozen RIA, pay base, thirteenth and TFR, Arts. 56, 58, 66, 73.
Arts. 60-61 night hourly allowance and on-call turn pay in the cached signed contract.
findings: PDF p. 90 confirms EUR 2.74 per night hour and EUR 21.69 per 12-hour on-call turn; shorter turns of at least four hours pay pro rata plus 10%. Holiday and radiation allowances remain outside the derived calculation.

reviews.scope: Art. 4 effective start, Art. 73 TFR elements and Arts. 60-61 eligibility limitations for new event rates.
findings: The signing date is 8 October 2020; Art. 4 makes the night and on-call event rates effective 9 October 2020.
Art. 73 lists TFR elements but does not name pronta disponibilità; non-TFR treatment remains an unverified modelling choice.
Art. 61(c) daily rotating shift allowances remain unmodelled; Art. 60 enterprise adoption and covered profiles are asserted by callers submitting events.
